user.title: Sign in to Skylight
user.description:
This unofficial integration only reads from your Skylight.

1. Open a new browser tab, press F12, open the **Network** tab, tick **Preserve log** and type `welcome` in the filter box.
2. In that tab, open [Skylight's sign-in page]({url}) and log in.
3. Copy the address of the `welcome?code=...` request and paste it below.

Skylight's welcome page removes the code from the address bar at once, which is why it has to be copied from the Network tab.

data.refresh_token: Refresh token (advanced, instead of the above)

error.invalid_auth: Skylight rejected that code or token. Codes expire within minutes; start again with a fresh sign-in.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Skylight, or Skylight retired the app version this integration sends. Check the log.

abort.already_configured: This Skylight is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That login belongs to a different Skylight.
abort.no_frames: This Skylight account has no calendars.
